rd.sentence: 4 required inputs missing and 2 still assumed

items.label: Scale
items.why: graphic-bar

items.label: Limit of work
items.why: with no limits line the region is wherever the two surfaces overlap, which bulges outside the graded area

items.label: Both surfaces
items.why: 42 and 22 distinct elevations

items.label: Elevations
items.why: 169 contour lines carry no height, so the surface is interpolated across them - measured on this corpus, that is the single biggest thing moving a volume

items.label: Topsoil strip
items.why: nothing is stripped, so the cut starts at the ground the sheet draws - 6 in of topsoil moved a measured sheet's cut by 30%

items.label: Dig depth below finish grade
items.why: the dig stops at finish grade, so any pavement or subgrade section is uncounted - 12 in moved a measured sheet's cut by 88%

items.label: Shrink and swell
items.why: no factor is applied, so these are neat in-place yards - hauled and compacted quantities differ

items.label: Redistribute and reuse
items.why: the default: site cut balances against site fill and everything stripped leaves the job

items.label: over-excavation and subsidence
items.why: not an input this software takes yet - allow for it outside the takeoff

items.label: rock and groundwater
items.why: not an input this software takes yet - allow for it outside the takeoff
